purpose: read-only freeze list that MUST exist before any 2022 evaluation (task §9.1); written before any 2022 performance was computed

candidates.recipe: TCN W20 (8 channels, 20 return steps from 21 price points, 32 channels, two residual blocks of two causal k3 convs, dilations 1/2), AdamW lr1e-3 wd1e-3, clip1, batch4 days, MSE, max80 epoch/patience10, inner IC epoch selection, outer refit from scratch, seed reset before every construction
0.5 x C1 (3 seeds, depth8/l2=15, per-seed inner IC tree selection) + 0.5 x TabM (3 seeds, k8/width128/2 blocks/dropout0.1, inner IC epoch selection)

c1_fixed.recipe: depth8/l2=15 RMSE, 25-tree inner IC selection, near-opt 0.0005 earliest, fold-local weights, 6 threads

tree_structure.recipe: TREE_v1 structure: 0.5 x L5 (311 rounds, fixed) + 0.5 x C1 (3 seeds)

bridge_reference.comparability: R_DEPLOY has no label_end<=20211231 model and no 2022 predictions; it is NOT usable as a 2022 control. Any R_DEPLOY number must be labelled as an annual-window reference only.

evaluation_boundaries.evaluation_days: 2022 legal signal days from the independent panel calendar
evaluation_boundaries.label_boundary: all models fitted with label_end_date <= 20211231; no 2022 label used for fitting or selection

block_bootstrap.scheme: fixed-length paired moving block, resampled per year with each year's day count preserved

decision_rule.primary_delta: dIC = IC(candidate fusion) - IC(tree_structure control), daily Spearman, same days/pool/label mask
decision_rule.support: primary dIC > 0 and both calendar halves of 2022 >= -0.001
decision_rule.reject: primary dIC <= 0 or a materially split half
decision_rule.on_reject: do not search other weights; report the fallback V1_FIXED_ANCHOR time-out-of-sample dIC against the same two controls and label it a validation of the existing anchor, not a new-candidate win
decision_rule.no_recall: no feature, seed, weight or algorithm change after opening 2022
